lines.speaker: max
lines.text: Jane, look! There's a green balloon stuck in that tree.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Oh no. Somebody must have lost it. Can we get it down?

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: I can't reach it. Maybe if I jump really, really high.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Wait, I have an idea. Let's ask the wind to help us.

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: Ask the wind? That's silly. Hey, it worked! Here it comes!

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Now let's find out who lost it. Teamwork!
